title: Design review across applications
slide_intent: Evaluate type alongside physical applications because a corporate face must work across different reading conditions.
strategic_value: Shared review of proofs, models and materials can expose inconsistencies before the Lufthansa system is rolled out.
demonstration: A group reviews papers and material samples around a table with identity boards on the walls.
practical_value: Bring type proofs and application samples into the same review.
